title: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky to Keep Full Company Duties While Leading New AI Startup

tickers.name: Airbnb, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The involvement of Brian Chesky in a privately funded artificial intelligence venture will not alter his responsibilities as chief executive of Airbnb, the company announced. Airbnb also stated that the duties of former Meta generative AI leader Al-Dahle will remain the same, despite his ownership of equity in the separate startup.

The stealth lab previously paid Airbnb $7.1 million in cash for expense reimbursements and the use of intellectual property. While Chesky retains a controlling interest and has self-funded the operation to date, Airbnb has secured a future option to license the venture's technology or invest capital into the business.
